figures.finding: No agreement or minimum for a director is set in the US Minor Outlying Islands, which have no permanent inhabitants; filming on the island refuges is allowed only by a federal permit (50 CFR 27.71, under 43 CFR part 5), and the US federal minimum wage and overtime rules (FLSA ss. 206-207) reach work on Wake Island and Johnston Island, not on the other islands.
